title: Application submitted
description: We received your application and created your FloLabs profile.
applicantAction: Make sure your profile details are complete and keep an eye on your dashboard.
adminAction: Review the new application and move the lead into the contacted stage.

title: New outreach
description: The applicant entered the funnel and is waiting for the first contact.
applicantAction: Wait for the first message from the HR team.
adminAction: Send the first outreach or let the automation handle it.

title: Websites and presentations form
description: The applicant was contacted and should complete the Websites & Presentations form.
applicantAction: Go through the material and complete Form 1.
adminAction: Track whether the form was sent and submitted.

title: Form 1 under review
description: Form 1 was submitted and is being reviewed for effort and quality.
applicantAction: Wait for the review result or a request to improve answers.
adminAction: Evaluate answers and move strong applicants to Before Meeting.

title: Meeting recordings
description: The applicant should watch the meeting recordings and complete the second form.
applicantAction: Watch the recordings and submit Form 2.
adminAction: Track completion and answer process questions.

title: Form 2 under review
description: Form 2 was submitted and is being reviewed.
applicantAction: Wait for the orientation invitation or a resubmission request.
adminAction: Review answers and decide whether to invite the applicant to Saturday Orientation.

title: Orientation session
description: The applicant was invited to the Saturday Orientation session.
applicantAction: Attend the orientation session or ask questions in chat.
adminAction: Track attendance and send the correct follow-up.

title: Masterclass assigned
description: The applicant attended the orientation session and should complete the General Masterclass step.
applicantAction: Complete the General Masterclass content and form.
adminAction: Wait for submission and answer questions.

title: Masterclass under review
description: The General Masterclass step has been submitted and is under review.
applicantAction: Wait for the next scheduling step.
adminAction: Review depth of answers and move approved applicants to Second Meeting.

title: Oliver 1-on-1
description: The applicant is ready to schedule the one-on-one with Oliver.
applicantAction: Share two or three availability slots when requested.
adminAction: Coordinate the one-on-one and log the outcome.

title: Agreement sent
description: The onboarding agreement and next access instructions were sent.
adminAction: Track signature, payment status, and reminders.

title: Agreement signed
description: The agreement is signed and the applicant is ready to be synced into Chronos and Team Members.
applicantAction: Wait for workspace access and Chronos activation.
adminAction: Create or update Chronos account and team member record.

title: Chronos synced
description: The shared FloLabs and Chronos identity is active.
applicantAction: Use the same credentials across FloLabs and Chronos.
adminAction: Confirm the onboarding stack is complete.

title: Joined
description: The applicant is now an active FloLabs team member in Chronos.
applicantAction: Use your FloLabs and Chronos access for active work.
adminAction: Track the person as fully joined and no longer as a pending lead.
